pages.text: Draw blood with a $(item)Syringe$(). Bloodless creatures need a $(item)Marrow Drill$(), $(item)Oil Tap$() or $(item)Ecto Trap$(), and bosses a $(item)Leviathan Needle$(). Healthy creatures give better samples. Spin a sample in the $(item)Centrifuge$(), then read the DNA in the $(item)DNA Sequencer$(): call the bases yourself for a better read.
